title: The owner merges the green-field reset over the record gate; the gate's blocking of release is future work
situation: Merging dev into main (PR 66) deletes 1,378 records under records/, the green-field reset of 0013, which already bypassed the record gate once by documented intent. In CI the gate runs first and fails, so neither the build nor the tests ran, and on main it fails the release workflow's gates, so no release can run while the push that carries the reset is the one being read. The operator, 2026-10-13: this is premature over-restriction that keeps causing blockers; bypass it for now to reach stable common ground, and address it after.
decision: The owner merged PR 66 over the failed gate. The release proceeds from the next push to main, whose range holds only additions. Revising the record gate under 0142's test, so that a documented, owner-decided change of history does not block the release pipeline, is future work, taken up right after this release.
consequences: A pull request carrying this entry is merged into main so the release workflow runs on a clean range and CI shows the build and tests green.
